freeplay_tips: Press SPACE to listen to the Song / Press CTRL to open the Gameplay Changers Menu / Press RESET to Reset your Score and Accuracy.
musicplayer_tip: Press SPACE to Pause / Press ESCAPE to Exit / Press R to Reset the Song
credits_tips: Press ACCEPT to Open the Selected Creator's Bilibili Homepage / Press BACK to Exit to the main menu
languages_tips: Press ACCEPT to Apply Changes and Back to Settings / Press BACK to Not apply Changes and Exit to the Settings
options_graphics_low_quality_tip:
If checked, disables some background details,
decreases loading times and improves performance.
options_graphics_anti_aliasing_tip:
If unchecked, disables anti-aliasing, increases performance
at the cost of sharper visuals.
options_graphics_shaders_tip:
If unchecked, disables shaders.
It's used for some visual effects, and also CPU intensive for weaker PCs.
options_graphics_gpu_tip:
If checked, allows the GPU to be used for caching textures, decreasing RAM usage.
Don't turn this on if you have a shitty Graphics Card.
options_ui_notespl_tip: Select your prefered Note Splash variation.
options_ui_notespl_alpha_tip: How much transparent should the Note Splashes be.
options_ui_hide_hud_tip: If checked, hides most HUD elements.
options_ui_flashing_lights_tip: Uncheck this if you're sensitive to flashing lights!
options_ui_zooming_tip: If unchecked, the camera won't zoom in on a beat hit.
options_ui_score_text_zoom_on_hit_tip:
If unchecked, disables the Score text growing
everytime you hit a note.
options_ui_health_alpha_tip: How much transparent should the health bar and icons be.
options_ui_pause_music_tip: What song do you prefer for the Pause Screen?
options_ui_drp_tip: Uncheck this to prevent accidental leaks, it will hide the Application from your 'Playing' box on Discord
options_ui_combo_stacking_tip: If unchecked, Ratings and Combo won't stack, saving on System Memory and making them easier to read
options_gameplay_downscroll_tip: If checked, notes go Down instead of Up, simple enough.
options_gameplay_middlescroll_tip: If checked, your notes get centered.
options_gameplay_opponent_notes_tip: If unchecked, opponent notes get hidden.
options_gameplay_autopause_tip: If checked, the game automatically pauses if the screen isn't on focus.
options_gameplay_disable_reset_button_ti: If checked, pressing Reset won't do anything.
options_gameplay_saon_tip:
If checked, Hold Notes can't be pressed if you miss,
and count as a single Hit/Miss.
Uncheck this if you prefer the old Input System.
options_gameplay_hitsound_tip: Funny notes does 'Tick!' when you hit them.
options_gameplay_rating_offset_tip:
Changes how late/early you have to hit for a 'Sick!'
Higher values mean you have to hit later.
options_gameplay_sick_offset_tip:
Changes the amount of time you have
for hitting a 'Sick!' in milliseconds.
options_gameplay_good_offset_tip:
Changes the amount of time you have
for hitting a 'Good' in milliseconds.
options_gameplay_bad_offset_tip:
Changes the amount of time you have
for hitting a 'Bad' in milliseconds.
options_gameplay_safe_frames_tip:
Changes how many frames you have for
hitting a note earlier or late.
